verdict.rationale: a-Shell is itself an official Unix-like terminal for iOS. Its first-party GitHub docs describe a broad command set (`help -l`, `pkg install`, `pip install`, clang/wasm, config, bookmarks), and Apple Shortcuts integration gives scripted, automatable control of the shell. Missing for 10: AI/agent-oriented documentation (llms.txt returns 404), documented machine-readable or structured output for agent consumption, independent hands-on corroboration.
